description: This file contains cryptographic functions implementing CTR mode encryption, including counter increment functions and encryption routines using AES, with internal static functions and assertions.

methods.name: ctr128_inc
methods.description: Increments a 128-bit counter represented as a byte array by 1.

methods.name: CRYPTO_ctr128_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on input data, updating counter state.

methods.name: ctr96_inc
methods.description: Increments the upper 96 bits of a 128-bit counter.

methods.name: CRYPTO_ctr128_encrypt_ctr32
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption with 32-bit counter, handling overflow and block processing.
